description: This file defines an enum `ExecApprovalCommandDisplaySanitizer` that provides functionality to sanitize strings by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode characters. It includes a set of Unicode scalar code points deemed invisible and offers methods to sanitize text, determine if a scalar should be escaped, and perform the escaping.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the input string by escaping invisible or formatting Unicode characters.

methods.name: shouldEscape
methods.description: Determines if a UnicodeScalar should be escaped based on its category or if it is an invisible code point.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Returns a string with the UnicodeScalar escaped in Unicode notation.
